pairs.gold_text: Deaths were reported in connection with the Aldan House collapse by November 8.
pairs.system_text: The Aldan House collapse caused deaths.

pairs.gold_text: Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.
pairs.system_text: Injuries were documented in the Aldan House collapse.

unmatched_gold.text: Nerridge fire service reported rescuing people during the initial response to the Aldan House collapse.
PUSAR reported rescuing people on November 4 and again on November 6.

pairs.gold_text: The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing.
pairs.system_text: Aldan House and its east wing were destroyed.

unmatched_gold.text: Later safety updates stated that the west wing had not collapsed.
The tower crane at the site was reported not to have fallen.

pairs.gold_text: Later updates reported restoration of the tower crane in Imber Street and restoration of Aldan House.
Service at Aldan House was disrupted; later, services were reported closed along Imber Street and Cobbett Row.
pairs.system_text: Services at Aldan House were disrupted following the collapse.

pairs.gold_text: About 85 people were reported displaced from Cobbett Row during the later phase of the response.
pairs.system_text: People were displaced from the area around Aldan House (Cobbett Row).

unmatched_gold.text: Dangerous conditions were reported at Cobbett Row while local services remained closed.
Assistance was provided in Cobbett Row during the later response.
Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed during the response and later reported rescuing people.
Nerridge Police deployed in the city during the later phase of the response.

unmatched_system.text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue rescued people from the Aldan House collapse.

unmatched_gold.text: Nerridge Police reported that no looting had been reported during the later response.
Requests for assistance were reported from Imber Street during the early phase of the emergency.
A warning was issued for Cobbett Row during the initial response to the collapse.
Assistance was provided in Cobbett Row during the response.
